description.blurb:
Beresheet is the first ever private mission to attempt to land on the Moon. It is the first Israeli Lunar lander, developed by SpaceIL – an Israeli nonprofit organization. During the landing and on the Lunar Surface, Beresheet will capture HD images and videos, measure the remnant magnetic field of the Moon with a designated Magnetometer ("SILMAG") and transmit the data to Earth. Beresheet also carries a Laser Retro Reflector Array for accurate geo-location on the Moon by LRO and other spacecrafts to come.

Aside from landing on the Moon and perform scientific experiments, SpaceIL’s collective vision is to create a new "Apollo Effect": to inspire the next generation around the world to embrace science, engineering, technology and math.
